raw_description: <p>At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. For 10 years, Scale has provided the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and has helped enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst &amp; Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force.</p> <p>Scale's internship is not a side project. Interns own real, shipped work on the same roadmaps as full-time engineers, with mentorship from world-class talent and a culture that values ownership, speed, and truth-seeking. Many of our interns return as full-time Scaliens.</p> <h2><strong>Example Projects</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build reinforcement learning and post-training data pipelines that power frontier model development</li> <li>Develop evaluation infrastructure that measures model reliability for enterprise and public sector customers</li> <li>Ship agentic AI applications and the tooling that makes them observable, testable, and safe to deploy</li> <li>Ship tools that accelerate the growth of new qualified contributors on Scale's platform</li> <li>Build fraud-detection systems that remove bad actors and keep Scale's contributor base safe and trusted</li> <li>Use models to estimate the quality of tasks and contributors, and guarantee quality on requests at large scale</li> <li>Devise advanced matching algorithms that pair contributors to customers for optimal turnaround and accuracy</li> <li>Create optimized and efficient UI/UX tooling, in combination with ML algorithms, for 100k+ contributors completing billions of complex tasks</li> <li>Develop new AI infrastructure products to visualize, query, and explore Scale data</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Requirements</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A graduation date in Fall 2027 or Spring 2028 with a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field (Computer Science, EECS, Computer Engineering, Statistics)</li> <li>Available for a customers, figuring out 'what' to build and then iterating</li> <li>Previous Computer Science/Software Engineering internship experience</li> <li>Track record of shipping high-quality products and features</li> <li>Experience building systems that process large volumes of data</li> <li>Experience with Python, Typescript, React, and/or MongoDB</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with LLMs, evaluations, or agentic systems — whether from coursework, research, or personal projects</li> <li>Open source contributions or a portfolio of shipped side projects</li> </ul> <h2><strong>How We Work</strong></h2> <p>Our credos shape how we make decisions and work as a team:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Earn Customer Love</strong> — trust is earned with every interaction, every delivery, and every problem we solve</li> <li><strong>Team Flow</strong> — ideas, energy, and support move freely across teams; optimize for the whole</li> <li><strong>Quality is Our Cheat Code</strong> — the systems that deliver quality consistently are a structural advantage</li> <li><strong>Find the 20%</strong> — find the inputs that drive the outcomes and execute them completely</li> <li><strong>Write the Market</strong> — our research puts us at the frontier, and we bring our partners there first</li> <li><strong>Three Moves Ahead</strong> — consider the consequences of consequences, and plan accordingly</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><em>PLEASE NOTE:&nbsp;</em></strong><em>Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.</em></p> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p><em>At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. raw_description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.</p></div><p>Design at Waymo is about the total experience—not just how the product looks, but how it works, how it feels, and how we make our new technology accessible, approachable, and useful for everyone. We design the intuitive, delightful experience for our riders, and we also build the powerful, complex tools used by our fleet operations teams and the engineers who build the Waymo Driver. We are a highly multidisciplinary team of UX Designers, User and Market Researchers, UX Engineers, Content Designers, Industrial Designers, CAD Designers, Studio Engineers, and Technical Artists. We dig deep to understand the attitudes, emotions, and behaviors of all our users. This understanding serves as the foundation for everything we create.</p> <p>Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!</p> <p><strong>You will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assist in the design, programming, and launching of surveys to potential users in London and Tokyo to understand travel behaviors, price sensitivity, feature preferences, and perceptions of autonomous vehicles.</li> <li>Analyze survey data and publicly available datasets to identify key market segments and growth opportunities.</li> <li>Support quantitative analysis of user feedback from early engagement programs or market simulations.</li> <li>Conduct comparative analyses of quantitative data across London, Tokyo, and existing US markets to inform localization strategies.</li> <li>Synthesize and visualize quantitative findings into clear reports and presentations for cross-functional partners in Product, Marketing, and Operations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>You have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Currently enrolled in a graduate program (Master's or PhD) in Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Marketing, or a related quantitative field.</li> <li>Strong understanding of quantitative research methods, statistical analysis, and survey design.</li> <li>Proficiency in programming languages used for data manipulation and statistics (e.g., R, Python, SQL) to query and analyze user-level observational data.</li> <li>Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills to present quantitative data clearly to stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We prefer:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Demonstrated interest in international markets, cultural differences, and global product localization.</li> <li>Experience conducting cross-cultural survey research or international comparative analyses.</li> <li>Experience analyzing large-scale public datasets or early-stage product engagement data.</li> </ul> <p>Note: This will be a hybrid onsite internship position. We will accept resumes on a rolling basis until the role is filled. To be in consideration for multiple roles, you will need to apply to each one individually - please apply to the top 3 roles you are interested in.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><div>The expected hourly rate for this full-time position is listed below. Interns are also eligible to participate in the Company’s generous benefits programs, subject to eligibility requirements.</div></div><div class="title">Hourly Masters Pay</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$70</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$70 USD</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><div>The expected hourly rate for this full-time position is listed below. Interns are also eligible to participate in the Company’s generous benefits programs, subject to eligibility requirements.</div></div><div class="title">Hourly PhD Pay</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$85</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$85 USD</span></div></div></div>

<h2><strong>Who we are</strong></h2> <h3><strong>About Stripe</strong></h3> <p>Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million <a href="https://stripe.com/customers">businesses</a> build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make <a href="https://stripe.com/roadmap">upgrades to our products</a> every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most <a href="https://status.stripe.com/">reliable APIs</a> on the internet. We build entirely new <a href="https://tempo.xyz/">pieces</a> of <a href="https://mpp.dev/">financial</a> <a href="https://joinopenstandard.com/">infrastructure</a> to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in <a href="https://stripe.com/radar">risk and fraud</a> infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.</p> <h2><strong>Your role</strong><strong><br></strong></h2> <p>Stripe is large enough that individual products and projects can be rapidly deployed to a meaningful fraction of the world’s businesses, but small enough that individual agency still has outsized impact. Small teams can impact how millions of businesses grow. Right now the global economy is replatforming around AI, creating new opportunities for growth. We’re at the center of this, and we think the best work is still in front of us.</p> <p>To meet this moment, we’re looking for people who move with urgency, like hard problems, and want their work to matter at a time of great change. If that’s you, there’s no better place to build your career.</p> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.</li> <li>Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple.
